summary.text: Steve Doyle is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 94 since May 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
An attorney and former University of Wisconsin-La Crosse professor, he served on the La Crosse County Board for 25 years.

paragraphs.text: Before his election to the Assembly, Steve Doyle was an attorney in private practice and a professor of political science at the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse.
He served on the La Crosse County Board for 25 years.
Doyle assumed office in the Assembly on May 17, 2011.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Commerce, Criminal Justice and Public Safety, Financial Institutions, and Insurance committees.
